module: Management of the editor's window layouts. Each layout is a folder settings/<tool>/layouts/<name>/ containing windowsState.json; the current layout is settings/<tool>/windowsState.json. The ImGui positions are read/written in settings/imgui.ini (or settings/default_imgui.ini for the Default layout). The tool is "editor" by default.
notes: Depends on editor.loadWindowsState / editor.saveWindowsState (defined elsewhere) and on ui_imgui.
saveCurrentWindowLayout does not pass toolName to editor.saveWindowsState, unlike saveWindowLayout and loadCurrentWindowLayout.
resetLayouts deletes all layouts whose path does not contain "/Default", then reloads Default.

getWindowLayouts.desc: Lists the layout folders of settings/<tool>/layouts/.

loadWindowLayout.desc: Loads the windowsState.json of a layout and reloads imgui.ini: default_imgui.ini if the layout is Default, otherwise imgui.ini.

saveWindowLayout.desc: Saves the windows state to settings/<tool>/layouts/<layoutName>/windowsState.json and saves imgui.ini.

loadCurrentWindowLayout.desc: Loads the current windows state (settings/<tool>/windowsState.json). If editor.needsDefaultImguiIniLoad is true, loads default_imgui.ini once, otherwise imgui.ini.

saveCurrentWindowLayout.desc: Saves the current windows state to settings/<tool>/windowsState.json and saves imgui.ini.

toolName.desc: Used to build the path, but is not passed to editor.saveWindowsState.

deleteWindowLayout.desc: Deletes all files of a layout folder then the folder itself.

layoutPath.desc: Path of the layout folder to delete.

resetLayouts.desc: Deletes all custom layouts (everything except Default) from settings/<tool>/layouts then loads the Default layout.
